description: Only Laboratory records with WBC strictly above 6.5 pass the filter; records with exactly 6.5 are excluded.

c.request: Taking individual lab records and using 6.5 as the white blood cell count (`WBC`) cutoff, group them by anti-centromere status (`CENTROMEA`), treating a missing status as its own group, and for each status work out the average AST minus ALT (`GOT` − `GPT`) and the average APTT minus PT (`APTT` − `PT`), skipping records where a difference can't be computed. Then give me a single row with two unrounded figures: the average of those per-status AST − ALT averages and the average of the per-status APTT − PT averages, with each status counting equally and missing per-status values ignored. Only Laboratory records with WBC strictly above 6.5 pass the filter; records with exactly 6.5 are excluded.
c.sql: WITH filtered_records AS (SELECT * FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC > 6.5), group_stats AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(CASE WHEN GOT IS NOT NULL AND GPT IS NOT NULL THEN GOT - GPT END) as avg_got_minus_gpt, AVG(CASE WHEN APPT IS NOT NULL AND PT IS NOT NULL THEN APPT - PT END) as avg_appt_minus_pt FROM filtered_records GROUP BY CENTROMEA) SELECT AVG(avg_got_minus_gpt) as avg_ast_minus_alt, AVG(avg_appt_minus_pt) as avg_appt_minus_pt FROM group_stats

b.request: Filter Laboratory records with WBC strictly greater than 6.5, group by CENTROMEA status treating NULL as a separate group, compute for each group the average of (GOT − GPT) and average of (APTT − PT) across records where both operands in each difference are non-NULL, then return the unweighted mean of the per-group (GOT − GPT) averages and the unweighted mean of the per-group (APTT − PT) averages, excluding any group that lacks a computable average for each metric.
b.sql: WITH filtered_records AS (SELECT * FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC > 6.5), group_stats AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(CASE WHEN GOT IS NOT NULL AND GPT IS NOT NULL THEN GOT - GPT ELSE NULL END) AS avg_got_gpt, AVG(CASE WHEN APTT IS NOT NULL AND PT IS NOT NULL THEN APTT - PT ELSE NULL END) AS avg_aptt_pt FROM filtered_records GROUP BY CENTROMEA), valid_groups AS (SELECT * FROM group_stats WHERE avg_got_gpt IS NOT NULL AND avg_appt_pt IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(avg_got_gpt) AS mean_got_gpt, AVG(avg_appt_pt) AS mean_aptt_pt FROM valid_groups
b.raw: Filter Laboratory records with WBC strictly greater than 6.5, group by CENTROMEA status treating NULL as a separate group, compute for each group the average of (GOT − GPT) and average of (APTT − PT) across records where both operands in each difference are non-NULL, then return the unweighted mean of the per-group (GOT − GPT) averages and the unweighted mean of the per-group (APTT − PT) averages, excluding any group that lacks a computable average for each metric.

a.request: Looking at individual lab records with a white blood cell count (`WBC`) strictly greater than 6.5, group them by anti-centromere status (`CENTROMEA`), treating a missing status as its own group, and for each status work out the average AST minus ALT (`GOT` − `GPT`) and the average APTT minus PT (`APTT` − `PT`), skipping records where a difference can't be computed. Then give me a single row with two unrounded figures: the average of those per-status AST − ALT averages and the average of the per-status APTT − PT averages, with each status counting equally and missing per-status values ignored.
a.sql: WITH filtered_records AS (SELECT * FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC > 6.5), status_averages AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(CASE WHEN GOT IS NOT NULL AND GPT IS NOT NULL THEN GOT - GPT ELSE NULL END) as avg_got_gpt_diff, AVG(CASE WHEN APPT IS NOT NULL AND PT IS NOT NULL THEN APPT - PT ELSE NULL END) as avg_appt_pt_diff FROM filtered_records GROUP BY CENTROMEA) SELECT AVG(avg_got_gpt_diff) as avg_ast_alt_overall, AVG(avg_appt_pt_diff) as avg_appt_pt_overall FROM status_averages

d.request: Filter Laboratory records to WBC > 6.5, partition by CENTROMEA with null as a separate group, calculate the mean of (GOT − GPT) per group excluding records with missing GOT or GPT, calculate the mean of (APPT − PT) per group excluding records with missing APPT or PT, return one row with the unrounded mean of the per-group (GOT − GPT) means and the unrounded mean of the per-group (APPT − PT) means, with equal weight per group and groups with no computable average excluded.
d.sql: WITH filtered_data AS (SELECT * FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC > 6.5), got_gpt_means AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(GOT - GPT) as mean_got_gpt FROM filtered_data WHERE GOT IS NOT NULL AND GPT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CENTROMEA), appt_pt_means AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(APPT - PT) as mean_appt_pt FROM filtered_data WHERE APPT IS NOT NULL AND PT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CENTROMEA), combined AS (SELECT COALESCE(g.CENTROMEA, a.CENTROMEA) as CENTROMEA, g.mean_got_gpt, a.mean_appt_pt FROM got_gpt_means g FULL OUTER JOIN appt_pt_means a ON g.CENTROMEA = a.CENTROMEA WHERE g.mean_got_gpt IS NOT NULL OR a.mean_appt_pt IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(mean_got_gpt) as avg_got_gpt, AVG(mean_appt_pt) as avg_appt_pt FROM combined;
